title: Termwise local model object comparisons and restriction of chain maps
statement: Choose the derived localizations of [def-pc-derived-category]. Let W be a scheme, U an open of W, E an object of D(O_W), and K a strictly perfect complex on the open site [def-pc-perfect-complex], with E restricted to U isomorphic to QK. There is no connectivity hypothesis. For each factorization t=s;U.ι with s:T→U, let P_s be the termwise tensor pullback along s of K transported by Modules.overEquiv U, and let A_t be the degree-zero single of the tensor pullback along t of O_W. There are simultaneous object isomorphisms a_t:Lt*(O_W[0])≅Q(A_t) and b_(t,s,h):Lt*E≅Q(P_s). For any i:T′→T and compatible t,t′,s,s′, and any chain map f:A_t→P_s, there exists a chain map f′:A_t′→P_s′ such that its degree-zero component, normalized by singleObjXSelf.inv, is the ordinary raw restriction of that of f [def-sc-picard-ordinary-model-cycles], and the restriction of a_t.hom;Q(f);b_(t,s,h).inv [def-sc-picard-derived-model-sections] is a_t′.hom;Q(f′);b_(t′,s′,h′).inv.

proof.text: Transport the fixed representing isomorphism along the exact open-site equivalence. Strict perfectness implies boundedness and flatness of each transported term. Apply the bounded-flat counit to every map s, and derived composition with s;U.ι=t. Apply the single-complex counit to the structure sheaf as well. These construct simultaneous source and target object isomorphisms a and b, without a connectivity hypothesis.

Termwise pull back an already given chain map f along i. Conjugate by the single-complex and underived composition isomorphisms, with equality transports ht and hs. The result f′ is a chain map. Its component in degree zero, after singleObjXSelf.inv, is the defined raw ordinary restriction. The other source terms are zero. The degree-zero equation follows by naturality of the single-complex identification.

Evaluate the defining counit equation of the canonical derived composition lift at the bounded K-flat model and the single unit. Their counits are invertible. Naturality at f identifies the two conjugated localized chain maps. The fixed model isomorphism cancels by naturality, and proof irrelevance identifies the equality transports. This gives the restriction equation for the localized chain map f; it does not assert that every derived map is represented by one.

proof_origin.description: Extracted object computation and restriction of chain maps from steps 1 and 3 of the connective comparison; connectivity and localization bijectivity are deliberately absent.

theorem picard_termwise_model_comparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (E : schemeDerivedCategory W) (U : W.Opens)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect W U K)
    (hE : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) :
    ∃ (a : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (t : T ⟶ W),
        (derivedPullback t).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace))) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj (picardTermwiseSource t))
      (b : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (t : T ⟶ W) (s : T ⟶ U.toScheme),
        s ≫ U.ι = t →
          ((derivedPullback t).obj E ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj (picardTermwiseModel W U K s))),
      ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (t : T ⟶ W) (t' : T' ⟶ W)
        (s : T ⟶ U.toScheme) (s' : T' ⟶ U.toScheme)
        (ht : i ≫ t = t') (hs : i ≫ s = s')
        (hf : s ≫ U.ι = t) (hf' : s' ≫ U.ι = t')
        (f : picardTermwiseSource t ⟶ picardTermwiseModel W U K s),
      ∃ f' : picardTermwiseSource t' ⟶ picardTermwiseModel W U K s',
        (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (.up ℤ) 0 _).inv ≫ f'.f 0 =
          picardOrdinaryModelRestriction W U K i t t' s s' ht hs
            ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (.up ℤ) 0 _).inv ≫ f.f 0) ∧
        picardDerivedModelRestriction E i t t' ht
            ((a t).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f ≫ (b t s hf).inv) =
          (a t').hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f' ≫ (b t' s' hf').inv
